patterns.note: A persistent left-hand navigation/information column is maintained while the main content area on the right undergoes significant, full-width layout transformations on scroll.
A strong typographic contrast is used, pairing oversized, elegant serif headings with small, uppercase monospaced text for navigation and body content.
The site uses a stark, high-contrast dark theme with a black background and white text, accented by a single vibrant blue for interactive elements and an animating graphic.

The right-hand content area completely swaps its visual layout and content type (e.g., from a three-image grid to a large text block, then to a full-page image gallery) as the user scrolls down the page.
A dynamic, abstract blue line graphic continuously animates and transforms its shape and position across the screen, responding to scroll depth.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate complex, full-screen layout transformations and content swaps in the main content area as the user scrolls, rather than simple element reveals.
A persistent SVG-based line graphic animates continuously and also responds to scroll depth by changing its form and position, creating a dynamic visual anchor.

The main content area dynamically loads and displays different types of content (e.g., a three-image grid, a large text block, a full gallery grid) based on scroll position, creating a narrative flow.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3x body) with small, uppercase monospaced navigation and body text.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, with significant negative space, especially in the initial and text-heavy sections, contrasting with a dense image gallery section.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its highly dynamic, almost interactive, scroll experience where the entire right panel transforms its content and layout, creating a narrative flow that feels more like an interactive art piece or presentation than a traditional website. The persistent, animating line graphic further enhances this unique, fluid feel.
